reading_rule.text: DES K6 (Part 2 section 10.3), written before the simulation runs: if the simulated familywise rate exceeds 6% at any simulated sigma, SR-2 is not adopted and N decides alone; else SR-2 stands and the size is printed. GXB S-1: the rule applies to every simulated scenario: a familywise rate above 6% at any simulated sigma, with or without the interaction and at either family ratio (every entry of 'interaction'; GXB R-12), and for any family read, means SR-2 is not adopted. It runs before block A's first pod, on the design that will run (the reduced design if an anchor-job stop is known before it runs; DESO3 V2; GXB S-10). The script prints this rule and a reading line beside its largest familywise rate over every sigma, scenario and family; the lead applies it. The familywise rate is the rate of the U claims (Holm on U at 5%; Part 2 section 10.3); Phi's O and L words are not simulated (GXB R-11).
reading_rule.source: DES K6 (.ai/inputs/stage1-post-w1-20261023/78b/lead-rulings-part2-design-20261106.md:62-64); Part 2 section 10.3; DESO3 V2 (DES:175-176); GXB second set S-1, S-10 (lead-rulings-ab-build-20261108.md:82-); GXB seventh set R-11, R-12 (lead-rulings-ab-build-20261108.md:199-)
reading_rule.applies_to: every sigma_pair of the grid x every scenario of 'interaction' (none, the two interaction shares, the two family ratios) x every family read (GXB S-1, R-12)

rule.source: P1 section 6.1 (ruling 3); the review ceiling and its factors as scripts/scale78b/noise_reading.py (THRESHOLD_A_PP, THRESHOLD_B9_PP, MDE_FACTOR, SESOI_PP; the tests check equality)

reml.source: B16's settings/reading.json reml block (LN-35; post-W1 deviation D-4), the stage-1 reading's form that P1 section 4 carries to 7-8B

n_stage.source: GXB S-7 (sigma_pool as noise_reading.py, its sigma_eval floor included; P1 section 3.3). sigma_eval,0 = the true prompt-clustered SE of a seed-matched a0-R pair: Gate B wave 0a's 1.28 pp (P1:179-180, the 1B pairing evidence; no 7-8B value exists before N); P = 200 harm prompts per cell (PR4:227)

approximations: The claim test is Holm at 5% (two-sided p) over the plan's primary U contrasts (Part 2 section 10.3's words), as a bound on B16's graphical family Phi over U, O, L and F (GXB S-2: adopted only if Phi's claim cannot pass without the U contrast passing its Holm test; the verifier checks it).
N's per-prompt values are the cell's U plus centred Gaussian prompt noise (not 0-1 shares of 3 samples); its sigma_eval,0 is the 1B value (n_stage).

Seed effects are set to 0: they cancel in every within-cluster contrast, in the additive model's residuals and, under the common-seed assumption, in N's pairs; a seed component that differs between the clusters (which would inflate N's pairs only) is not simulated.
The arm x seed scenarios add an independent N(0, share x sigma_e^2) term to every method-arm cell (A1, L1, H1, S1, S3, S4) and none to a0 and R, at shares 0.5 and 1 (GXB S-1).
Branch H is read as H (b) with its money covered (ruling 4's first choice; GXB S-4).
Cells alone at their seed in a cluster (R and a0 at 1101) are left out of the REML fits, which changes nothing in B16's fit (leverage 1; the tests check it against B16's fit_cells with them in).

Under [B] the scenarios none, arm x seed 0.5 and arm x seed 1 give both families one true sigma_pair; P1 section 3.6 (N2) expects them to differ. Two scenarios at share 0 set Llama-3.1-8B's sigma_pair at 3/2 and 2/3 times OLMo-2-7B's (the grid's sigma), capped at the grid's top (GXB R-12; the verifier's SV-3). Under [C] these two equal 'none' except N's printed plan.
limits: The crossed prompt (item) part of each claim-test contrast's SE is omitted: no prompt-level data exist before block A, so none are simulated for the claim test; the df is the seed part's Satterthwaite df (GXB S-3). Its effect on the size is not simulated: V_prompt >= 0 widens the SE but also raises the Satterthwaite df.

The familywise rate is the rate of the U claims: Holm at 5% on the U contrasts, which bounds Phi's U claims (GXB R-10). Phi's adverse O and L words ('worse (O)', 'worse (L)'), which start at gamma x alpha = 0.5% absolute in all (10% of alpha, alpha = 5%), within their own contrasts, are not simulated (GXB R-11 as corrected by R-27).
